search_text: published ZDI-21-359 ZDI-CAN-12122 NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System MibController realName Directory Traversal Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2021-03-26 CVE-2021-27276 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-27276 7.1 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H ['NETGEAR'] ['ProSAFE Network Management System'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the MibController class. title: NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System MibController realName Directory Traversal Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the MibController class. When parsing the realName parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
